accepted.label: Sensitivity Analysis by Changing Input Parameters
accepted.description: After building the simulation, change an input mean (e.g., Fixed Costs) to observe the impact on risk of loss, demonstrating how Monte Carlo simulation supports decision-making under uncertainty.
coverage_criteria: Student can adjust a parameter (e.g., increase Fixed Costs) and predict how the risk of loss would change.
Student can interpret the new risk percentage in context of a business decision (e.g., '21% risk now, so maybe we should reduce fixed costs').
accepted.merge_rationale: Single candidate capturing a distinct teachable step in Monte Carlo simulation.
